name: AsyncConfigPortal
description: Reusable modular web configuration portal for ESP32 and ESP8266 (Arduino). Provides HTTP digest auth, a dynamic menu, a system Status page, an Other page (OTA with firmware-marker validation, restart, backup, password change), and a composition API (addPage / addJsonEndpoint / addPostHandler) for project-specific pages. Ships an optional, opt-in network-configuration module that carries no mandatory dependency on the NetworkProfile family.
keywords: esp32, esp8266, web, configuration, ota, async, http, digest-auth, arduino
